PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. We evaluate PPNAS in end-to-end predictor-based NAS, where it achieves state-of-the-art under limited evaluation budgets. To the best of our knowledge, PPNAS is the first prediction-powered approach for label-efficient NAS.

</details>


### [332] [Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01318)
*Hanna Malet,Gabriel Turinici*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在有限预算管线中，扩散模型即使保留全部历史与真实数据，仅通过对增长数据池的固定规模采样训练，仍会出现部分而非完全的模式坍塌；其退化程度取决于特征的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究对模型坍塌结论看似矛盾：替换真实数据会导致坍塌，而累积真实数据可防止坍塌。作者希望厘清两种协议差异，并刻画介于二者之间的现实有限预算训练情形。

Method: 在2D螺旋数据及MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10上比较替换协议与固定预算协议；并建立多代参数动力学的线性响应模型，用随机递归进行分析。

Result: 替换协议如文献所述快速退化数据集；固定预算协议仅部分退化，保留部分特征。线性响应模型证实两协议不同：某些特征在两种协议下数代内脆弱丢失，而另一些在固定预算下可在近乎无界的时程内稳健保留。

Conclusion: 模型坍塌并非全有或全无，固定预算抽样下的扩散模型表现出特征依赖的选择性退化；真实数据比例趋零但不移除数据时，部分特征仍能长期存活。

Abstract: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

</details>


### [333] [Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01322)
*Kotaro Kamiya,Joel Nicholls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN)，一种面向几何图的等变层状（sheaf）神经网络：在每个 cellular sheaf 的 stalk 上放置 Clifford 代数，并沿边传输 multivector 特征。作者放弃代数同态约束，转而采用 K-term sandwich 限制映射，使 sheaf Laplacian 天然半正定、无需 versor 约束且仍能混合 grade。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在代数值 stalk 的 sheaf 中，限制映射的自然选择是代数同态；加入等变约束后，最朴素的选择变为 versor 共轭。但 versor 共轭表达力弱，限制了模型的表达能力。因此作者希望找到一种既能保持等变性、又能增强表达力并保证 Laplacian 半正定的限制映射形式。

Method: 作者在 cellular sheaf 的每个 stalk 上引入 Clifford 代数，并沿边传输 multivector 特征。他们放弃代数同态要求，采用 K-term sandwich 作为限制映射，并构造相应的 sheaf Laplacian。随后从三个维度刻画该限制映射族：耦合哪些 grade、能达到内同态空间的多少部分、以及条件数好坏。CSNN 对应其中的 reversion 成员，是构造上的一阶模型，也是该族中 grade-mixing 的极端情形。

Result: K-term sandwich 构造的 sheaf Laplacian 按构造即为半正定，无需 versor 约束，同时仍能混合 grade。该映射族可覆盖内同态空间的一半；在 Cl(3, 0, 0) 中，它对应于与中心 pseudoscalar 对易的映射。项数 K 控制表达力，CSNN 作为 reversion 成员是该族中 grade-mixing 的极端情形。

Conclusion: CSNN 为图级等变回归提供了一种基于 sheaf 的构造，通过 K-term sandwich 在保持等变性与半正定性的同时增强了表达力，并通过项数 K 调节模型能力。

Abstract: We introduce the Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN), an equivariant sheaf neural network for geometric graphs that places a Clifford algebra on each stalk of a cellular sheaf and transports multivector features along edges. The canonical choice of restriction map for sheaves with algebra-valued stalks is algebra homomorphism. Adding the constraint of equivariance, the naive choice becomes versor conjugation. However, versor conjugation is expressively weak, so we drop algebra homomorphism and arrive at the K-term sandwich. The resulting sheaf Laplacian is positive semidefinite by construction, needs no versor constraint, and still mixes grades. Our main contribution characterizes the resulting family of restriction maps along three axes: which grades a map couples, how much of the endomorphism space it reaches, and how well it is conditioned. The K-term sandwich spans half of the endomorphism space, and in Cl(3, 0, 0) it corresponds to the maps that commute with the central pseudoscalar. The number of terms controls expressivity. CSNN is the reversion member, a first-order model by construction and the grade-mixing corner of this family, developed as a sheaf construction for graph-level equivariant regression.

</details>


### [334] [Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01343)
*Anthony Dugois,Vincent Fagnon,Giorgio Lucarelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非先知（non-clairvoyant）单机调度中最小化完工时间之和的问题，提出利用分类模型提供的结构信息（混淆矩阵）构建鲁棒性框架，将不确定性刻画为各类内排列集合，并给出在三种鲁棒准则下均最优的非自适应策略，同时研究自适应与随机算法在特定矩阵结构下的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非先知单机调度中，作业处理时间未知，无法获得常数竞争比的算法，经典鲁棒优化指标（Min-Max、Min-Max Regret）又存在计算困难。作者借用鲁棒优化与学习增强算法思想，希望利用分类模型给出的结构信息突破该局限。

Method: 假设作业被划分为若干类，并已知分类器的混淆矩阵，其中第(k,ℓ)项表示被预测为第k类但实际属于第ℓ类的作业数量。由此将不确定性刻画为每个预测类内的排列集合，而非离散数值情景集合，从而规避经典鲁棒指标的计算难题。在此基础上，除最坏情形指标外还考虑所有情景下的期望目标，设计非自适应策略，并进一步研究自适应与随机算法。

Result: 首先提出一个对所有三种鲁棒准则（Min-Max、Min-Max Regret及期望目标）均免疫（oblivious）的最优非自适应策略；随后证明当混淆矩阵具有特定结构性质时，自适应与随机算法能够优于该最优非自适应策略。

Conclusion: 利用分类模型混淆矩阵提供的结构信息，可在非先知单机调度中获得同时满足多种鲁棒准则的最优非自适应策略；在混淆矩阵具有特殊结构时，自适应与随机算法可进一步提升性能，表明学习增强的结构化不确定性建模对突破经典不可能性结果具有价值。

Abstract: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computational difficulty of classical robust metrics, such as Min-Max and Min-Max Regret. In addition to these worst-case metrics, we also consider the expected objective over all scenarios. We first propose an optimal non-adaptive strategy that is oblivious with respect to all three robust criteria. We then investigate adaptive and randomized algorithms, showing that they can outperform the optimal non-adaptive strategy when the matrix exhibits particular structural properties.

</details>


### [335] [Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01355)
*Alessandro Micheli,Andrea Zerio,Samir Bhatt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出离散漂移（Discrete Drifting）框架，在有限状态空间上实现一步生成建模：用离散Wasserstein几何定义目标相对KL梯度流，经马尔可夫跳跃在粒子层面实现并摊销为隐条件生成器，使迭代动态仅在训练时需要，推理保持一步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 漂移（drifting）类一步生成方法此前主要适用于连续域，难以直接推广到有限/离散状态空间；而结构化离散数据（如序列、图、组合结构）缺乏相应的一步生成理论基础与可验证构造。

Method: 1) 借助离散Wasserstein几何，在可逆马尔可夫核的转移上定义目标相对的KL梯度流；2) 通过马尔可夫跳跃在粒子层面实现该概率流；3) 将由此得到的传输更新摊销（amortize）为隐变量条件生成器，使迭代动力学只在训练阶段出现，推理阶段为单步生成；4) 在分布与传输动力学可精确计算的受控设定下进行验证。

Result: 在受控设定中验证了：KL耗散性、粒子动力学与概率流之间的一致性，以及预测的数值缩放规律；进一步表明有限容量的神经网络生成器能够跟踪这些精确传输目标，同时保持一步生成能力。

Conclusion: 结果验证了该基本构造的正确性，为将Discrete Drifting扩展到结构化离散数据奠定了基础。

Abstract: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

</details>


### [336] [Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01356)
*Simon Heilig,Jens Püttschneider,Mohammad Itani,Asja Fischer,Timm Faulwasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文突破了稳定端口哈密顿神经网络只能表示单一吸引子的限制，通过将哈密顿量参数化为Bregman散度的乘积，使其能够表示具有双势阱等多吸引子的动力学系统，并提供了稳定性理论证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稳定端口哈密顿神经网络（port-Hamiltonian neural networks）通过构造方式保证渐近稳定性，但其哈密顿量作为具有单一全局最小值的全局Lyapunov函数，只能表示具有单一吸引子的动力学系统。这排除了即使是简单的双势阱能量景观系统，因此需要一种能表示多吸引子系统同时保持稳定性保证的方法。

Method: 将哈密顿量参数化为由单个输入凸网络（input-convex network）生成的Bregman散度的乘积，从而构建能表示多吸引子能量景观的模型。

Result: 证明了所得模型具有局部Lyapunov稳定性；稳定平衡点的共存必然导致额外非渐近稳定平衡点的存在；所有平衡点位于有界区域内；在双曲性假设下几乎处处稳定性成立。在三个系统上，该方法能够恢复能量面特征并将收敛速度提升1.8倍至8.5倍。

Conclusion: 通过Bregman散度乘积的参数化方式，成功克服了稳定端口哈密顿神经网络单一吸引子的限制，在保持理论稳定性保证的同时实现了多吸引子系统的表示，并显著提升了收敛速度。

Abstract: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

</details>


### [337] [From Redundancy to Minimality: Fixed-Point-Guided Hierarchical Reduction of Learned Piecewise-Linear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01369)
*Hiroto Tamura,Gouhei Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于不动点引导的分层约简方法，先训练具有冗余ReLU单元的AL-RNN，再逐步线性化ReLU单元以获得最小动力学表示，并证明Q个不动点至少需要Q个含不动点符号的最小性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从时间序列中学习非线性动力系统的极简表示很困难：直接用最少数量的ReLU单元训练AL-RNN不可靠，难以稳定得到最小动力学表示。作者希望借助多余的ReLU容量作为"脚手架"，提升最小表示的可发现性与可靠性。

Method: 提出不动点引导的分层约简流程：逐步线性化被选中的ReLU单元，合并相邻线性区域与符号图节点，同时保留包含不动点（FP）的不同符号。约简过程形成一棵约简树，给出由繁到简的候选层次；每个约简候选由父代参数初始化，并在父代动力学引导下重新训练。

Result: 证明再现Q个不同不动点至少需要Q个含不动点符号，从而在该下界达到时提供符号级最小性证明。在3-scroll Chua系统上，直接用理论最少3个ReLU单元训练仅20%随机种子成功；而"学习-约简-重训"策略在相同最终非线性容量下将种子宏平均成功率提升至约71%。

Conclusion: 冗余的非线性容量可以作为发现并实现最小动力学表示的有效脚手架，结合约简与重训可显著提升最小表示学习的可靠性，并给出符号级最小性的理论判据。

Abstract: Understanding a nonlinear dynamical system from time series requires not only reproducing its trajectories, but also identifying a simple representation that preserves its essential dynamical structure. Almost-linear recurrent neural networks (AL-RNNs) are piecewise-linear RNNs in which only a subset of units use ReLU nonlinearities, so that nonlinear capacity is explicitly controlled by the number of ReLU units. Their activation patterns define linear regions, represented as symbols, whose observed transitions form a symbolic transition graph. However, directly training AL-RNNs with few ReLU units to realize minimal dynamical representations can be unreliable. We ask whether an AL-RNN with more ReLU units can instead be trained first and systematically reduced to a minimal dynamical representation. We introduce a fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction procedure that progressively linearizes selected ReLU units, merging neighboring linear regions and graph nodes while preserving distinct symbols containing fixed points (FPs). The resulting reduction tree defines a hierarchy of progressively simpler candidates. Each reduced candidate is initialized from the parent parameters and retrained under guidance from the parent dynamics. We also prove that reproducing $Q$ distinct fixed points requires at least $Q$ FP-containing symbols, providing a certificate of symbol-level minimality when this bound is attained. On the 3-scroll Chua system, direct training with the theoretical minimum of three ReLU units achieves high-fidelity minimal realizations in only 20% of seeds, whereas our learn-reduce-retrain strategy increases the seed-macro success rate to approximately 71% at the same final nonlinear capacity. These results show that redundant nonlinear capacity can serve as a scaffold for discovering and realizing minimal dynamical representations.

</details>


### [338] [Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01373)
*Michael Hauri,Peter Buttaroni,Fabian A. Mikulasch,Friedemann Zenke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CTWM（通勤时间保持的世界模型），通过结合潜在位移预测器与对数行列式正则化器，在可逆确定性动力学下可证明地恢复正确缩放的拉普拉斯表示，从而在连续环境中实现高效的目标导向规划，并以一半参数量在多个基准上匹配或超越LeWM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型通过在潜在空间中选择能最大程度缩短与目标状态距离的动作序列来进行规划，因此规划性能依赖于潜在表示的距离能反映环境中的通勤时间（commute-time）。图拉普拉斯谱嵌入空间可提供这种表示，但需满足特定的特征值相关缩放。然而在大规模连续环境中显式构建图拉普拉斯不可行。自监督学习虽可扩展地学习此类嵌入，但现有方法常通过鼓励各向同性表示来防止表示塌缩，这会破坏"正确"的特征值相关缩放，导致对通勤时间的表示不准确。

Method: 提出通勤时间保持世界模型（CTWMs），包含两个核心组件：(1) 潜在位移预测器（latent displacement predictor）；(2) 对数行列式正则化器（log-determinant regularizer），用于防止表示塌缩。作者证明，在可逆确定性动力学下且在预测器的不动点处，该组合可证明地恢复正确缩放的拉普拉斯表示。

Result: 在数值模拟中，CTWM在若干复杂的连续目标到达基准任务上匹配或超越了任务无关基线LeWM，同时仅使用一半的参数量。

Conclusion: CTWM通过位移预测与对数行列式正则化的结合，规避了传统各向同性正则化对特征值缩放的破坏，实现了可扩展且理论可证的commute-time保持嵌入，为连续环境中的高效潜在空间规划提供了更参数高效的方案。

Abstract: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.

</details>


### [339] [Action-On-Item Preference Flow: A Shared Event Schema for Predictive and Generative Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01375)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Kashish Kanjaria,Vashisth Purani,Sourish Dasgupta,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究能否用一条可复用的更新机制跨电影、新闻、对话等异构用户历史来更新用户记忆，提出action-on-item模式与MTSH假设，并实现PerTIDE模型，在PENS、MovieLens、MIND上验证跨源迁移与多个消费任务的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户的电影、新闻与对话历史在原生的动作和输出形式上各不相同，但每次交互都提供了可更新用户记忆的证据。作者希望验证这些异构历史能否训练出统一的、可复用的更新机制，从而实现跨源知识迁移与共享参数。

Method: 提出action-on-item模式：将映射后的交互角色与内容嵌入配对，使共享更新参数作用于各自的用户状态。理论上建立三重性质：对原生标签重标的不变性、项目嵌入扰动下有界状态变化、显式兼容条件下的池化训练界。提出Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis（MTSH）刻画证据如何进入、保持与被消费；PerTIDE据此实现，包含动作门控、三条状态空间轨迹、融合与命令条件读出。

Result: 在PENS上，同一历史编码器同时支持下一新闻预测与个性化标题生成。受控的PENS-to-MovieLens实验中，冻结的源训练核心在拟合相同目标消费者后比同结构随机核心高出15.23 MRR。在MIND上，PerTIDE相较同输入的三分支状态空间对照保留4.12点MRR优势。动作、读出与轨迹的干预实验揭示了各组件对增益的互补贡献。

Conclusion: 理论与实验共同表明：可以在兼容来源之间学习历史更新机制，并通过预测式与生成式消费器复用它，验证了跨异构历史复用统一用户记忆更新机制及MTSH假设的有效性。

Abstract: A user's movie, news, and dialogue histories differ in their native actions and outputs, yet each interaction supplies evidence that can update user memory. We study whether these histories can train one reusable update mechanism. An action-on-item schema pairs a mapped interaction role with a content embedding, allowing shared update parameters to operate on separate user states. We establish invariance to native relabeling, bounded state changes under item-embedding perturbations, and a pooled-training bound under explicit compatibility conditions. The Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis (MTSH) specifies how this evidence enters, persists, and is consumed; PerTIDE implements it with action gating, three state-space traces, fusion, and command-conditioned readout. On PENS, the same history encoder supports both next-news prediction and personalized headline generation. In a controlled PENS-to-MovieLens experiment, a frozen source-trained core exceeds an identically structured random core by 15.23 MRR points after fitting the same target consumer. On MIND, PerTIDE retains a 4.12-point MRR advantage over a same-input three-branch state-space control. Action, readout, and trace interventions identify complementary contributions to these gains. Together, the theory and experiments support learning history updates across compatible sources and reusing them through predictive and generative consumers.

</details>


### [340] [Minimax Optimal Regret for Causal Logistic Bandits with Counterfactual Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01377)
*Junhyuk Huh,Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了带反事实公平约束的因果逻辑赌博机，证明了覆盖条件的必要性、给出 $V_\star$ 信息尺度下的下界，并设计两类算法达到匹配的上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的分析要么忽略覆盖条件，要么施加过强条件，且未建立匹配下界。本文旨在厘清反事实可行性方向不可辨识时，覆盖条件的必要性并刻画从事实反馈估计反事实效应的内在难度。

Method: 在事实与反事实特征映射共享未知逻辑奖励参数、但仅观测事实奖励的设定下：(1) 构造事实不可区分但最优公平动作不同的环境证明覆盖条件的必要性；(2) 在跨动作合并的事实协方差满秩条件（较弱的满秩条件）下，定义目标特定信息尺度 $V_\star$；(3) 给出基于 $V_\star$ 调参的探索-利用算法，以及无需知道 $V_\star$ 的自适应算法。

Result: 下界：任何策略期望联合损失 $\Omega([V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}]^{1/3}T^{2/3})$；上界：两类算法均达 $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}([V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+\kappa d/\sigma_0^2)$，其中 $R_T$ 为相对最优公平动作的遗憾，$V_T$ 为累积阶段正违反量。上下界在 $T$、$V_\star$、$\min\{\log K,d\}$ 的主导依赖上匹配（差对数因子）。

Conclusion: 覆盖条件对反事实公平逻辑赌博机是必需的；在较弱满秩条件下，$V_\star$ 精确刻画了联合损失与违反量的复杂度，且所提算法在 $T$ 依赖上达到最优（至对数因子）。

Abstract: We study causal logistic bandits with counterfactual fairness constraints. The causal structure is given through known factual and counterfactual feature maps that share an unknown logistic reward parameter, but the learner observes only factual rewards. Consequently, the directions determining counterfactual feasibility need not be identifiable from the available feedback. The closest prior analyses either omit a coverage condition or impose a comparatively strong one, and do not establish matching lower bounds. We first show that some coverage condition is necessary: without a coverage-type restriction, factually indistinguishable environments with different optimal fair actions force $Ω(T)$ expected joint loss. Under a weaker full-rank condition on the factual covariance pooled across actions, we identify a target-specific information scale $V_\star$ that measures the difficulty of estimating rewards and counterfactual effects from factual feedback. We construct worst-case families satisfying this condition on which every policy incurs expected joint loss $Ω\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}\right)$. We also give an explore--then--exploit procedure tuned using $V_\star$ and an adaptive algorithm that does not require its value. Both algorithms achieve $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ_0^2\right)$, where $R_T$ is regret relative to the best fair action and $V_T$ denotes the cumulative stage-wise positive violations. Thus the upper and lower bounds match in their leading dependence on $T$, $V_\star$, and $\min\{\log K,d\}$, up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [341] [Robust Evidential Learning Through Latent Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01384)
*Charmaine Barker,Daniel Bethell,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CLEAR是一种轻量级、任务无关的后处理方法，通过在校准数据上刻画潜空间的分组几何结构，并在推理时于潜空间生成扰动视图来衡量冲突，从而选择性地削弱不受支持的证据强度，提升证据深度学习的不确定性鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的不确定性量化对深度学习在高风险场景的部署至关重要，因为分布外（OOD）和对抗输入容易产生高置信但不可靠的预测。证据深度学习（EDL）虽能在单次前向传播中高效给出不确定性估计，但仍可能对学习表示支持不足的输入（如对抗样本）赋予过高的证据强度，因此需要一种无需重训练即可增强证据鲁棒性的方法。

Method: CLEAR是一种轻量级、任务无关的后处理方法，不需重训练也不改变基础预测。它利用留出的校准数据刻画模型潜空间的“分组条件几何结构”；推理时在潜空间中高效生成扰动视图，并度量其相对于预测组已校准几何结构的冲突程度。高潜空间冲突意味着证据缺乏支持，据此选择性地降低证据强度，同时对潜空间一致的输入保留其证据。

Result: 在 ImageNet→CUB 任务上，CLEAR 将 OOD 和对抗 AUROC 分别提升 +8.29 和 +5.01，同时比竞争性后处理方法的运行速度快 17.4 倍，并在分类、回归和目标检测基准上保持预测性能。

Conclusion: CLEAR表明，仅通过潜空间几何校准与冲突度量即可有效提升证据深度学习的不确定性鲁棒性，兼具高效性与任务通用性，且不牺牲原有预测性能，为高风险场景下的可靠部署提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes settings, where out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs can induce confident but unreliable predictions. Evidential Deep Learning provides efficient uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass, but can still assign high evidential strength to inputs that are poorly supported by the learned representation, such as adversarial inputs. We introduce CLEAR, a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that improves evidential robustness without retraining or altering the base prediction. Using held-out calibration data, CLEAR characterises the group-conditioned geometry of the model's latent space. At inference, it efficiently generates perturbation views directly in the latent space and measures their conflict relative to the calibrated geometry of the predicted group. High latent conflict indicates unsupported evidence, which CLEAR uses to selectively reduce evidential strength while retaining evidence for latent-consistent inputs. On ImageNet$\rightarrow$CUB, CLEAR improves OOD and adversarial AUROC by $+8.29$ and $+5.01$ while running 17.4$\times$ faster than competing post-hoc methods while preserving predictive performance across classification, regression, and object detection benchmarks.

</details>


### [342] [AF-Muon: An AdamW-Free Muon Optimizer for Tied-Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01395)
*Arash Lagzian,Paniz Halvachi,Junming Zhang,Zhouhan Lin,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 AF-Muon，一种无需 AdamW 的 Muon 扩展：对隐藏权重矩阵保留 Muon 谱范数最速下降更新，对绑定词表使用支持集感知的有限容量线性最小化 oracle，对一维辅助参数使用 RMS 归一化更新，从而仅用单一一阶矩缓冲训练所有参数类，节省约 20% 优化器状态内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 通过谱范数最速下降更新改善了大规模训练，但实际模型包含不符合稠密矩阵几何的参数块。典型如绑定词表（tied vocabulary table），它同时接收稀疏输入查表与稠密输出分类器两类结构不同的梯度来源。参考方案将其交给辅助 AdamW，恢复了二阶矩状态并以通用张量方式更新混叠表，带来额外内存与几何不匹配问题。

Method: AF-Muon 保持隐藏权重矩阵的 Muon 矩阵更新；对绑定词表采用支持集感知的有限容量线性最小化 oracle（support-aware finite-cap LMO）；对一维辅助参数采用 RMS 归一化更新。整体仅需单一 first-moment 缓冲，不含 second-moment 状态。

Result: 在九个绑定 token 设定中（124M–1B 的 decoder-only LM、完全共享的 T5 风格 encoder-decoder，以及 ImageGPT 风格图像 token、蛋白质与稀疏 MoE 变体，覆盖文本、图像、蛋白质序列），AF-Muon 相比 Hybrid Muon 与 SCION 风格 Sign 端点均改善平均验证损失与困惑度；长时程运行与超参敏感性研究验证其稳健性；同动量诊断将收益归因于有限容量，其在约束行 RMS 坐标集中度的同时保留了更多行内幅度。

Conclusion: 绑定词表是一种独特的优化器几何。AF-Muon 作为稳健的、无需 AdamW 的 Muon 变体，跨模型、模态与架构取得一致改进，在匹配训练下步时开销约 1%。

Abstract: Muon improves large-scale training by applying a spectral-norm steepest-descent update to matrix parameters, but practical models also contain parameter blocks that do not fit dense-matrix geometry. One important case is the tied vocabulary table, which appears in language models and other token generators and can receive multiple structurally different gradient sources, from sparse input lookups to dense output-classifier updates. In the reference recipe these blocks are handed to an auxiliary AdamW optimizer, which restores second-moment state and updates the aliased table as a generic tensor. We propose AF-Muon, an AdamW-free extension of Muon that keeps the Muon matrix update for hidden weight matrices while using a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle for tied vocabulary tables and an RMS-normalized update for one-dimensional auxiliary parameters. AF-Muon therefore trains every parameter class with a single first-moment buffer and no second-moment state, saving around 20% optimizer-state memory relative to Hybrid Muon in our benchmark. Across nine tied-token settings - decoder-only language models from 124M to 1B parameters, a fully shared T5-style encoder-decoder, and ImageGPT-style image-token, protein, and sparse-MoE variants, spanning text, image, and protein-sequence data - AF-Muon improves mean validation loss and perplexity over both Hybrid Muon and a SCION-style Sign endpoint. Long-horizon runs and hyperparameter sensitivity studies confirm the gain is robust, and identical-momentum diagnostics attribute it to the finite cap, which preserves more within-row magnitude than Sign while bounding the coordinate concentration of row-RMS. These results identify tied vocabulary tables as a distinct optimizer geometry and yield a robust AdamW-free Muon variant across models, modalities, and architectures, with about 1% step-time overhead in matched training.

</details>


### [343] [Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01399)
*Alessandro Montenegro,Riccardo Venturelli,Marco Mussi,Matteo Papini,Alberto Maria Metelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在多重重要性加权框架下实例化 wPPO-U 与 wPPO-BH 两种样本复用变体，仅复用近期迭代样本以隔离数据复用效应，推导策略改进下界，并在连续控制任务上系统研究 PPO 中样本复用何时及如何提升样本效率或最终性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPO 已成为在线策略深度强化学习的事实标准，但在线方法样本效率低：当前策略采集的新数据仅更新几次即被丢弃。离线策略方法通过经验回放提升样本效率，却带来训练不稳定或大量调参成本。因此出现以离线数据复用增强 PPO 的混合策略，虽已显示样本效率提升，但缺乏对"复用何时有用、在何种场景、程度如何"的系统研究。

Method: 在多重重要性加权（multiple importance weighting）框架下实例化两种 PPO 变体：wPPO-U 采用普通重要性权重，wPPO-BH 采用平衡启发式校正的重要性权重。二者均保留 PPO 核心机制，仅复用来自近期若干迭代窗口内的样本，从而将数据复用效应与其他因素隔离。针对两种变体分别推导策略改进下界，为其损失函数提供理论依据。

Result: 在连续控制任务上进行了实证研究，考察数据复用何时以及如何提升 PPO 的样本效率或最终性能；两种变体均获得了对应的策略改进下界作为理论支撑。

Conclusion: 通过受控的样本复用变体与理论下界，本文为 PPO 中数据复用的有效性提供了系统性分析框架与实证证据，明确了复用带来收益的条件与程度。

Abstract: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. In this work, we study the effectiveness of sample reuse in PPO by instantiating two variants within a multiple importance weighting framework. Both retain the core PPO mechanics, reusing only samples from a window of recent iterations, thereby isolating the effect of data reuse from other factors. The variants, termed wPPO-U and wPPO-BH, employ vanilla importance weights or balance-heuristic-corrected ones, respectively. For both, we derive policy improvement lower bounds providing theoretical grounding for their respective losses. We use them to empirically study when and how data reuse improves sample efficiency or final performance of PPO across continuous control tasks.

</details>


### [344] [Why Does Train-Validation Separation Emerge? Update-Pressure Density Dynamics in Pretrained Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01425)
*Yuchen Li,Mingyu Du,Zongqi Fan,Ken-Tye Yong,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"动态结构"解释：预训练模型适配过程中，更新需求从可广泛复用的支撑转向更窄、迁移性更弱的支撑，导致训练-验证性能差距扩大，并以梯度分配异质性作为可观测指标，在合成层级、NLP和视觉任务中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练-验证分离（训练集表现与有限留出验证集表现之间的差距）随适配演化的机制尚缺乏结构性解释。作者希望刻画该差距如何随训练推进而发展，并找到无需验证样本进入读数、即可观测其结构演化的监测指标。

Method: 提出条件局部模型，将更新需求由"广复用支撑"向"窄支撑"的转移，与梯度分配异质性上升及训练-验证分离联系起来。使用固定训练探针（fixed training probes）使该结构演化可观测，验证性能仅用于单独评估其与差距的关系。实验包括：(1) 残差多层感知机（ResMLP）构造的特征层级，调节样本私有特征目标占比 p=.3/.5/.7，保持四级共享特征相对混合比 1:2:3:4，每条件五次运行；(2) 在六个数据集上对 RoBERTa、DeBERTa、Qwen 进行 10 轮训练，共 90 次运行，采用探针加权的类内与整体离散度读数；(3) ResNet-18 在三个视觉数据集上的 40 轮研究。

Result: ResMLP 中，随私有特征占比由 .3 增至 .5、.7，最终平均准确率差距从 .185 增至 .331、.527。训练与验证样本上分别测量的掩码输入损失揭示了相应的迁移不对称性。NLP 的 90 次运行中，两种离散度读数与准确率差距的原始及平滑水平相关性均为正；约一轮间隔配对的原始变化在 86/90 与 87/90 次运行中保持正相关。视觉研究对两种读数进行了检验。

Conclusion: 受控仿真、NLP 与视觉三方面证据共同支持该动态结构解释在多种设定下的适用性，真实模型证据在指定监测器下检验了其可观测预测。

Abstract: Train-validation separation is the evolving difference between performance on observed training examples and a finite held-out validation set. We propose a dynamic structural account of how this gap develops during adaptation of pretrained models: continued fitting can shift update demand from broadly reusable support toward narrower support with weaker held-out transfer. A conditional local model links this shift to increasing heterogeneity in gradient allocation and train-validation separation. Fixed training probes make this structural evolution observable without validation examples entering the readouts; held-out performance is used separately to evaluate its relation to the gap. In a constructed hierarchy implemented with a residual multilayer perceptron (ResMLP), increasing the target share of example-private features from $p=.3$ to $.5$ to $.7$, while preserving the relative mixture $1{:}2{:}3{:}4$ among the four shared feature levels, increases the final mean accuracy gap from $.185$ to $.331$ to $.527$ across five runs per condition. Masked-input losses measured separately on training and validation examples expose the corresponding transfer asymmetry. The natural language processing (NLP) analysis uses 10-epoch runs of RoBERTa, DeBERTa, and Qwen on six datasets (90 runs): the training-probe-weighted within-class and overall dispersion readouts each have positive raw and smoothed level correlations with the accuracy gap in all 90 runs. Raw changes paired at approximately one-epoch intervals remain positively associated in 86/90 and 87/90 runs, respectively. A 40-epoch ResNet-18 study tests both readouts on three vision datasets. Together, controlled simulation, NLP, and vision support the dynamic structural account across settings, with real-model evidence testing its observable predictions under the specified monitors.

</details>


### [345] [Least-time Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01426)
*Alessandro Betti,Marco Gori,Stefano Melacci,Jinwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究梯度流在风险层面上的时间最优重参数化问题，通过对速度函数u的正则化变分问题，证明最优u*存在唯一且为线性缩放的摆线，并给出零点附近速率u*(e)~(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}的渐近行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 若直接令梯度流满足ẇ=-u(E(w))∇E(w)/|∇E(w)|²，则风险e(t)=E(w(t))精确满足ė=-u(e)，与景观E无关，从e0到零风险的时间为∫₀^{e0}de/u(e)。仅最小化该时间是不适定的，因此需要引入正则化以得到良定义的优化问题。

Method: 考察正则化变分问题 inf{∫₀^{e0}(λ/2|u'|²+1/u)de : u∈H¹(0,e0), u≥0, u(0)=0}，λ>0。证明路线为经典方法：用直接法证明存在性，用严格凸性证明唯一性，证明极小值在远离原点处为正，并显式积分Euler-Lagrange方程求解。

Result: 极小值存在且唯一，其形式为线性缩放的摆线；最优速率在零风险附近满足u*(e)~(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}，指数2/3与文献中幂律试探解所得一致，且落在Hölder窗口(1/2,1)内，对应有限时间到达且速度权重趋于零的情形。

Conclusion: 在风险动力学层面通过正则化变分可唯一确定梯度流的速度调度；最优解为缩放摆线，其零点附近呈2/3次幂律，从而在理论上解释了先前幂律试探所观察到的指数，并刻画了有限时间到达的Hölder正则性区间。

Abstract: Prescribing the speed of gradient flow on the risk itself, by the dynamics $\dot w=-u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/\abs{\nabla E(w)}^{2}$, makes the risk $e(t)=E(w(t))$ obey $\dot e=-u(e)$ exactly, whatever the landscape~$E$; the time needed to reach zero risk from $e_0$ is $\int_0^{e_0}\dd e/u(e)$. Minimizing this time alone is ill posed, and we study the regularized problem $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2\abs{u'}^{2}+1/u)\,\dd e:\ u\in H^{1}(0,e_0),\ u\ge0,\ u(0)=0\}$, $λ>0$. We prove that the minimizer exists, is unique, and is a linearly scaled cycloid, and we show that the optimal rate behaves like $u^{*}(e)\sim(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$ near zero risk: the exponent $2/3$ is the one found in \cite{betti2026holder} by a power-law ansatz, and it lies in the Hölder window $(\tfrac12,1)$ where the arrival is in finite time with vanishing weight speed. The proof follows the classical route: existence by the direct method, uniqueness by strict convexity, positivity of the minimizer away from the origin, and the explicit integration of the Euler-Lagrange equation.

</details>


### [346] [Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models into Efficient Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01435)
*Minho Jeong,Dooho Lee,Jinmo Lee,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何将表格基础模型（TFM）的预测能力蒸馏到轻量级、数据集特定的学生模型中，并给出了一套有效的蒸馏配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFM 虽通过上下文学习取得强预测性能，但反复依赖标注数据进行条件化推理导致推断成本高昂；知识蒸馏可将其能力迁移到轻量学生模型以降低成本，但 TFM 预测同时依赖标注上下文与查询，由此引出两个设计问题：如何构造教师监督信号，以及扩大查询覆盖是否有助于蒸馏。

Method: 在两种 TFM 以及神经网络与树模型两类学生模型上考察上述问题，并据此推导蒸馏配方：使用完整标注训练集作为教师上下文，仅基于教师对观测查询与合成查询的预测来训练学生模型。

Result: 在 TabArena 上，所得学生模型比经过监督训练、调参并集成的对应模型高出 57–98 Elo 分；将同一配方原样应用于 TALENT，在 300 个数据集中的 236–258 个上改善了匹配的默认学生模型，主指标中位误差降低 4.0–6.4%；蒸馏学生相对教师获得 3.0–21.6 倍的中位推理加速。

Conclusion: 该蒸馏配方无需改动即可跨 TFM 与学生模型类型迁移，在预测性能与重复推理成本之间提供了实用折中，并已开源代码。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance through in-context learning, yet repeatedly conditioning on labeled data makes inference expensive. Knowledge distillation can reduce this cost by transferring their predictive ability to lightweight, dataset-specific students. However, the dependence of TFM predictions on both a labeled context and a query introduces two design questions: how to construct teacher supervision and whether expanding query coverage improves distillation. We examine these questions across two TFMs and both neural and tree-based students, and derive an effective distillation recipe. The recipe uses the full labeled training set as teacher context and trains students solely on teacher predictions for observed and synthetic queries. On TabArena, the resulting students outperform their supervised trained tuned-and-ensembled counterparts by 57-98 Elo points. Applied unchanged to TALENT, the same recipe improves matched default students on 236-258 of 300 datasets and reduces median primary error by 4.0-6.4%. The distilled students also achieve median inference speedups of 3.0-21.6 times over their teachers, offering a practical trade-off between predictive performance and repeated inference cost. Code is available at https://github.com/nums-ai/TFM_Distillation .

</details>


### [347] [ibUMAP: Coherent and Scalable Field Evaluation for UMAP Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01445)
*Bin Chen,Yumeng Xue,Patrick Paetzold,Yunhai Wang,Oliver Deussen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ibUMAP，一种基于相干场的UMAP替代方法，通过共享嵌入快照同步计算吸引与排斥力，其度加权排斥场由负采样的条件期望推导，并用三个标量矩结合插值FFT高效评估，在CPU和GPU上实现显著加速并提升运行稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UMAP依赖随机负采样实现可扩展的布局优化，但这种随机性会导致重复运行及下游复用中的嵌入不稳定，因为估计的排斥力依赖于采样事件的顺序。

Method: 提出ibUMAP相干场方法：从共享嵌入快照评估吸引与排斥并同步施加；其度加权排斥场由固定嵌入下负采样的条件期望导出，用三个标量矩表示，并通过基于插值的FFT方案在CPU和GPU上高效计算，避免显式全对计算。

Result: 受控实验显示同步性和核截断会改变局部-全局保真度权衡，FFT评估对最终质量的平均影响较小；端到端基准测试显示，CPU上相对umap-learn中位数加速3.29倍（无种子）和5.79倍（有种子），GPU无种子执行下在百万级数据集上相对cuML加速1.44倍，同时运行间稳定性更好。

Conclusion: ibUMAP通过相干场公式替代随机负采样，在避免显式全对计算的同时诱导出不同于标准在线UMAP的优化动态，实现了显著加速与更强的运行稳定性，但伴随可测量的保真度权衡。

Abstract: UMAP achieves scalable layout optimization through stochastic negative sampling. However, this stochasticity can lead to unstable embeddings across reruns and downstream reuse, as the estimated repulsive forces depend on the ordering of sampling events. We present ibUMAP, a coherent field-based alternative that evaluates attraction and repulsion from a shared embedding snapshot and applies them synchronously. Its degree-weighted repulsive field is motivated by the conditional expectation of negative sampling for a fixed embedding and represented by three scalar moments, which are evaluated efficiently on CPUs and GPUs using an interpolation-based FFT scheme. This formulation avoids explicit all-pairs computations while inducing optimization dynamics that differ from those of standard online UMAP. Controlled experiments show that synchrony and kernel capping alter the local-global fidelity trade-off, whereas FFT evaluation produces small average changes in final quality. End-to-end benchmarks show median speedups of 3.29x unseeded and 5.79x seeded over umap-learn on CPU, and 1.44x over cuML on million-scale datasets under unseeded GPU execution. These gains accompany greater run-to-run stability and measurable fidelity trade-offs.

</details>


### [348] [Repurposing Obsolete Representations for Post-Deployment Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01453)
*Daniel Bethell,Charmaine Barker,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Deep Repurposing (DR)，一种无需梯度更新的后处理框架，用于在任务需求变化导致部分输出空间失效时对模型进行适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期部署的深度神经网络在训练后任务需求可能变化，导致原输出空间中的某些类别或预测行为变得过时；现有方法要么保留过时行为，要么需要昂贵的微调。

Method: DR估计过时区域与保留区域的潜在几何结构，移除支持过时行为的成分，并通过解析修复映射（analytic repair map）重新分配与保留任务兼容的证据，全程无需梯度更新。

Result: 在多种任务设定下，DR移除了过时行为并保留了保留任务的效用；在分类基准上，其保留准确率匹配或超过竞争性的遗忘与编辑基线，消除了过时预测，且适配速度比竞争性遗忘方法快至多60倍。

Conclusion: DR为任务过时场景提供了一种高效的后处理适配方案，可在不进行梯度更新的情况下修复预测与表示，兼顾遗忘过时行为与保持保留任务性能。

Abstract: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed in long-lived systems, where task requirements may change after training. In such settings, part of the original output space may become obsolete: a class, prediction region, or learned behaviour may no longer be valid. Existing approaches either leave the obsolete behaviour intact or require fine-tuning, which can be expensive. We propose Deep Repurposing (DR), a post-hoc framework for adapting models under task obsolescence. DR estimates the latent geometry of obsolete and retained regions, removes obsolete-supporting components, and reallocates retained-compatible evidence through an analytic repair map without gradient updates. This yields repaired predictions and representations in which obsolete regions no longer act as valid outputs, while useful obsolete structure can support the retained task. Across multiple task settings, DR removes obsolete behaviour while preserving retained utility. More importantly, across classification benchmarks, DR matches or exceeds competing unlearning and editing baselines in retained accuracy, eliminates obsolete predictions, and adapts up to $60\times$ faster than competing unlearning methods.

</details>


### [349] [Streaming algorithms for robust max-min diversification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01456)
*Andrea Pietracaprina,Geppino Pucci,Stefano Zanon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出了[Amagata, AAAI23]中鲁棒最大-最小多样化流式算法的三个缺陷，并提出一种确定性的基于coreset的算法：在自然的inlier-outlier分离假设下返回恰好k个inliers，达到$(2+\varepsilon)$近似，单遍流式实现可自适应doubling dimension $D$，内存与均摊更新时间在较宽参数范围内独立于$n$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: max-min diversification目标函数对噪声点高度敏感。[Amagata, AAAI23]提出鲁棒表述（排除由最近邻距离最大的$z$个outliers构成的解）及基于coreset的流式算法，但该算法存在三方面不足：(1) coreset构造需对$X$离线计算，内存线性于$n$，与流处理目标相悖；(2) 从coreset提取解的单遍过程会永久丢弃离当前解过远的点，可能返回少于$k$个点，导致不可行解；(3) outlier排除保证仅为概率性，且随coreset缩小而减弱。本文旨在克服这些缺陷。

Method: 提出一种确定性的基于coreset的算法，在自然的inlier-outlier分离假设（类似[Amagata, AAAI23]所用）下工作。算法返回恰好$k$个inliers，构成$(2+\varepsilon)$近似解，对任意$\varepsilon>0$成立，仅比最优多项式时间顺序近似差$\varepsilon$，即使在无outliers时也如此。其单遍流式实现可 oblivious 地适应数据集的doubling dimension $D$。

Result: 对于较宽范围的$k$、$z$、$\varepsilon$和$D$，算法使用独立于$n$的内存；对于足够长的流，其均摊更新时间与coreset大小成正比，因而也独立于$n$。同时保证返回恰好$k$个点（可行解）以及确定性的outlier排除。

Conclusion: 该工作通过确定性coreset构造与自适应流式实现，解决了先前算法在内存、可行性与保证强度上的缺陷，在保持接近最优顺序近似比的同时，实现了内存与更新时间对$n$的独立性。

Abstract: Given a set of $n$ points $X$ in a metric space and an integer $k$, max-min diversification aims to select $k$ points of $X$ maximizing their minimum pairwise distance. This objective function is however highly vulnerable to noisy points. In[Amagata, AAAI23], a robust formulation is proposed which addresses this vulnerability by excluding solutions containing any of $z$ outliers, defined as the $z$ points in $X$ with the largest nearest-neighbor distances. That paper also presents a coreset-based streaming algorithm for the new formulation, based on a suitable inlier-outlier separation assumption. However, we identify three shortcomings in the algorithm by [Amagata, AAAI23]: its coreset construction requires an offline computation over $X$, which needs memory linear in $n$, in stark contrast with the typical goals of stream processing; the one-pass procedure used to extract the solution from the coreset may return fewer than $k$ points (hence, an unfeasible solution) because it permanently discards points too far from the current solution; and its outlier-exclusion guarantee is only probabilistic and weakens as the coreset size shrinks. In contrast, we present a deterministic coreset-based algorithm that, under a natural inlier-outlier separation assumption (similar to the one used in [Amagata, AAAI23]), returns exactly $k$ inliers which are a $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximate solution, for any $\varepsilon>0$, thus only $\varepsilon$ above the best polynomial-time sequential approximation, even without outliers. Its one-pass streaming implementation adapts obliviously to the dataset's doubling dimension $D$ and, for wide ranges of $k$, $z$, $\varepsilon$, and $D$, it uses memory independent of $n$. For sufficiently long streams, its amortized update time is proportional to the coreset size, thus also independent of $n$.

</details>


### [350] [Tight Transition Time Bounds for Separable Logistic Regression at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01459)
*Haodong Wen,Kaiyue Wen,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大常数步长梯度下降下线可分logistic回归的Edge of Stability现象，否证了"任意维度下过渡时间与步长无关"的猜想，证明最坏情况过渡时间为Θ((logη)^{min{n-2,d-2}})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作仅给出d=2时η→∞的紧Θ(1)界，并猜想任意维度d≥2下界与η无关。本文旨在检验并否证该猜想，刻画过渡时间对η和维度的精确依赖。

Method: 针对梯度贡献最大的样本在迭代中反复切换这一核心困难，采用对维度d与样本量n的归纳法控制此类切换，并构造匹配的困难实例以给出下界。

Result: 对任意固定样本量n≥2及充分小间隔γ，最坏情况过渡时间为Θ((logη)^{min{n-2,d-2}})，且对d≥2一致成立。

Conclusion: 该结果否证了过渡时间与步长无关的猜想，揭示过渡时间随η呈对数多项式增长，其指数由样本量与维度的较小者决定。

Abstract: We study logistic regression on linearly separable data under gradient descent with a large constant stepsize $η$. Such dynamics may exhibit a characteristic Edge of Stability phenomenon, in which the loss initially oscillates before transitioning to a stable phase of monotone decrease. Existing work provides a tight $Θ(1)$ bound in dimension $d=2$ as $η\to \infty$ and conjectures a bound independent of $η$ in arbitrary dimensions $d\geq 2$. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture by showing that, for every fixed sample size $n\geq 2$ and sufficiently small margin $γ$, the worst-case transition time is $$Θ\!\left((\logη)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}}\right)$$ uniformly over $d\geq2$. The key challenge in establishing a tight bound is that the sample contributing most strongly to the gradient can change repeatedly across iterations. To address this issue, we control such changes by induction on dimension and sample size, and construct matching hard instances.

</details>


### [351] [Let the Heads Talk: Beyond Diagonal Graph Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01494)
*Riccardo Ali,Alessio Borgi,Mario Severino,Alessio Gravina,Davide Bacciu,Pietro Liò,Christopher Irwin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过quiver表示分离出sheaf神经网络中的矩阵值传输原语，揭示标准多头注意力仅实现对角边映射，提出Topological Attention（Top-A）以学习边依赖的非对角跨头路由，实验表明跨头传输在任务需要交互依赖变换时最有用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sheaf神经网络用局部特征空间间的线性传输映射替代标量边权，但其矩阵值传输的作用与sheaf-diffusion整体构造纠缠在一起，难以厘清传输原语本身的计算贡献。

Method: 利用quiver表示分离传输原语，并与多头注意力建立直接联系：将注意力头视为局部传输空间坐标，发现标准多头注意力实现对角边映射（源头仅能贡献给对应接收头）；允许非对角项即实现邻域聚合前的边条件跨头通信，并证明该操作一般无法被聚合后的单一共享线性映射吸收。据此提出Top-A，学习边依赖的非对角路由，保留原始同头路径，并在额外路由消失时精确退化为vanilla注意力。

Result: 在关系推理、异构图学习、算法推理（含分布外泛化）上评估Top-A，以异配节点分类作为对照。结果显示跨头传输在任务受益于交互依赖变换时最有用，而单纯的异配性并不提供系统性优势。

Conclusion: 边条件的跨头通信是矩阵值传输的一个独立计算原语，将sheaf传输与注意力机制统一起来，并明确了其适用条件。

Abstract: Sheaf Neural Networks generalize scalar-weighted message passing by replacing scalar edge weights with linear transport maps between local feature spaces. Yet the role of this matrix-valued transport is entangled with the broader sheaf-diffusion construction. We isolate the transport primitive through quiver representations and establish a direct connection with multi-head attention. Treating attention heads as coordinates of a local transport space reveals that standard multi-head attention implements diagonal edge maps: along each directed interaction, a source head can contribute only to the corresponding receiver head. Allowing off-diagonal entries instead enables edge-conditioned communication across heads before neighborhood aggregation. We show that this operation cannot, in general, be absorbed into a single shared linear map applied after aggregation. Building on this characterization, we introduce Topological Attention (Top-A), a multi-head attention that learns edge-dependent off-diagonal routes while preserving the original same-head paths and exactly recovering vanilla attention when the additional routing vanishes. We evaluate Top-A on relational reasoning, heterogeneous graph learning, and algorithmic reasoning, including out-of-distribution generalization, with heterophilic node classification as a contrast setting. The results show that cross-head transport is most useful when the task benefits from interaction-dependent transformations, while heterophily alone provides no systematic advantage. These findings identify edge-conditioned cross-head communication as a distinct computational primitive of matrix-valued transport.

</details>


### [352] [Learned End-to-End Guidance Schedules for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01502)
*Aneesh Barthakur,Mathias Niepert,Luiz F. O. Chamon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEEGS，一种端到端学习的时变引导调度，用较少采样步数在扩散模型引导生成中权衡数据质量与约束满足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引导扩散通过添加可微损失梯度作为漂移项来施加约束，引导尺度决定数据质量与需求满足之间的权衡。为同时兼顾两者，通常需使用较小引导尺度并延长采样，导致计算成本高昂。

Method: LEEGS在少量样本上通过随机梯度下降优化一个时间相关的引导调度，以最小化引导函数。由于直接对引导采样反向传播代价高，采用梯度近似，将训练时间缩短约4倍。

Result: 在图像修复、含噪图像逆问题、Face-ID引导生成以及正/逆向PDE问题等多种引导任务上，LEEGS在相同预算（50或100 NFE）下优于基线，或以仅10%的步数达到与常数引导相当的效果。

Conclusion: 学习式端到端引导调度可在显著减少采样步数的同时兼顾生成质量与约束满足，验证了其在多领域引导任务中的通用性与高效性。

Abstract: Diffusion models are a powerful generative paradigm used across multimedia and scientific applications. Guided diffusion methods impose requirements on the generation by adding the gradient of a differentiable loss (the guidance function) as a drift term during inference. The weight of this drift (the guidance scale) is critical for the trade-off between data quality and requirement satisfaction. To achieve both of these goals, guided diffusion must resort to small guidance scales and lengthy sampling, incurring high computational costs. This work proposes learned end-to-end guidance schedules (LEEGS) to achieve these objectives with fewer sampling steps. LEEGS trains a time-dependent schedule by minimizing the guidance function over a small set of examples using stochastic gradient descent. Backpropagating through guided sampling is computationally expensive, so LEEGS uses an approximation of the gradient that cuts training time by a factor of 4. We evaluate LEEGS on diverse guidance tasks, including (a) image inpainting, (b) noisy image inverse problems, (c) face-ID-guided generation, and (d) forward and inverse PDE problems, outperforming baselines at equal budget (50 or 100 NFEs), or matching constant guidance with only 10% of the steps.

</details>


### [353] [FedMIX-P: Mixing Local and Global Preconditioners for Federated Vision and Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01515)
*Junkang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedMIX-P在每个本地步骤混合共享与本地预条件算子，将均方算子失配降低λ²倍，并在平滑非凸随机优化下给出O(R^{-1/2})的平稳性界，实验在视觉与语言任务上优于对应本地优化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应预条件器可加速模型训练，但异构客户端的几何差异会即便在相同模型处评估梯度时也使联邦更新产生偏差；仅在轮次开始时同步无法阻止这种失配在本地训练过程中再次出现。

Method: 提出FedMIX-P，在每个本地步骤混合共享预条件器与本地预条件器，保留本地自适应的同时将均方算子失配降低λ²倍。针对带随机梯度和部分参与的平滑非凸目标，采用合适步长与随训练进程变化的混合权重，建立O(R^{-1/2})平稳性界，且不要求本地预条件器彼此收敛。理论覆盖有界线性对称正定预条件器。用双客户端反例说明固定正混合可能保留非平稳不动点。

Result: 实验在视觉与语言任务上使用SOAP、Sophia和Muon变体，相较相应的本地优化器均取得提升，包括最高19.47个百分点的准确率增益，以及在60M–350M语言模型上更低的验证损失。

Conclusion: FedMIX-P通过逐步混合共享与本地预条件器有效缓解异构几何导致的联邦偏差，理论保证不依赖本地预条件器收敛。完整非线性与基于动量的更新仍需单独分析。

Abstract: Adaptive preconditioners accelerate model training, but heterogeneous client geometries can bias federated updates even when gradients are evaluated at the same model. Round-start synchronization alone cannot prevent this mismatch from reappearing during local training. We propose \texttt{FedMIX-P}, which mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step, retaining local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of $λ^2$. For smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation, we establish an $O(R^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound using suitable stepsizes and a horizon-dependent mixing weight, without requiring local preconditioners to converge to one another. A two-client counterexample shows that fixed positive mixing can preserve a nonstationary fixed point. The theory covers bounded linear symmetric positive-definite preconditioners. Experiments with SOAP, Sophia, and Muon variants across vision and language tasks show improvements over corresponding local optimizers, including accuracy gains of up to $19.47$ percentage points and lower validation loss for 60M--350M language models. Full nonlinear and momentum-based updates require separate analysis.

</details>


### [354] [Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01519)
*Samuele Bortolotti,Weixin Chen,Han Zhao,Andrea Passerini,Stefano Teso,Antonio Vergari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 auto-nesy-bench 基准，评估 LLM 自动形式化文本知识为符号约束的能力，及其对神经符号预测器下游准确率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经符号（NeSy）预测器需将领域知识编码为逻辑公式以保证输出满足约束，但该过程高度依赖人工与专家，成为范式瓶颈。作者希望探究 LLM 自动形式化能否系统性地将文本知识转化为可嵌入 NeSy 预测器的符号知识。

Method: 引入 auto-nesy-bench，一个用于评估约束形式化及其对 NeSy 预测器下游准确率影响的新基准；在多个领域开展广泛评估，比较 LLM 生成公式与人类专家公式，并分析语法有效性与下游预测质量的关系。

Result: LLM 能在有意义程度上完成约束形式化，生成的公式常与人类专家提供的相似；当生成公式语法有效时，可带来高质量的下游预测。

Conclusion: LLM 自动形式化是缓解 NeSy 约束获取瓶颈的可行途径；代码与基准已公开于 https://unitn-sml.github.io/auto-nesy-bench/。

Abstract: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) predictors incorporate prior knowledge into the prediction process of neural networks, ensuring that outputs satisfy specified constraints, making them particularly suitable for high-stakes applications where compliance with domain knowledge is essential. A key bottleneck in this paradigm is the acquisition of symbolic constraints: encoding domain knowledge into logical formulas remains a manual and expert-intensive process. In this work, we investigate the extent to which auto-formalization via LLMs can systematically translate textual knowledge into symbolic knowledge that can be plugged into NeSy predictors. To this end, we introduce auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for evaluating constraint formalization and its impact on downstream accuracy of NeSy predictors. Through an extensive evaluation across several domains, we find that LLMs can formalize constraints to a meaningful extent, generating formulas that are often similar to those provided by human experts. Moreover, when the generated formulas are syntactically valid, they can lead to high-quality downstream predictions. The code and benchmark are available at https://unitn-sml.github.io/auto-nesy-bench/.

</details>


### [355] [Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning: Replacing Target Samples by Black-Box Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01522)
*Vladimir R. Kostic,Karim Lounici,Hélène Halconruy,Timothée Devergne,Michele Parrinello,Massimiliano Pontil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LITL框架，仅用有偏源样本的黑盒反馈即可恢复目标Langevin动力学，学习生成元的主导谱结构与投影漂移，并给出有限样本泛化保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学和机器学习系统多由具低维慢时间尺度结构的随机动力学支配，但用于识别和解释此类动力学的目标轨迹常不可得，只能获得有偏或静态样本。

Method: LITL通过Dirichlet表示学习学习目标无穷小生成子的主导谱结构与投影漂移，实现谱形式动力学重构与慢流形梯度场估计；并引入球面变体以引导归一化潜表示；给出特征值、特征函数和投影漂移在Sobolev范数下的有限样本保证。

Result: 从有偏分子模拟中恢复物理跃迁时间尺度，从生成模型静态样本构建动力学结构，重建物理系统的球面对称性，并在黑盒反馈下实现已训练神经网络的事后潜空间引导。

Conclusion: 谱算子学习可作为在分布偏移下恢复随机动力学的实用框架，并在机器学习与物理科学中广泛应用。

Abstract: Many scientific and machine learning systems, from molecular dynamics to diffusion models and beyond, are governed by stochastic dynamics with low-dimensional structure, evolving on slow timescales. However, target trajectories, used to identify and interpret such dynamics, are often inaccessible: only biased or static samples that explore the underlying manifold are available. We introduce Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL), a framework for recovering target Langevin dynamics from biased source samples using only black-box feedback. LITL learns the leading spectral structure of the target infinitesimal generator and the projected drift through Dirichlet representation learning, enabling kinetic reconstruction in spectral form and slow-manifold gradient field estimation. We further introduce a spherical variant well suited to steering normalized latent representations commonly used in learning systems toward desired objectives. We establish finite-sample guarantees for eigenvalue, eigenfunction, and projected drift estimation in Sobolev norms, thereby ensuring generalization of these quantities and their first-order derivatives. Empirically, LITL recovers physical transition timescales from biased molecular simulations, builds kinetic structure from static samples of generative models, reconstructs spherical symmetries of physical systems, and enables post-hoc latent steering of trained neural networks under black-box feedback. Together, these results position spectral operator learning as a practical framework for recovering stochastic dynamics under distribution shift and unlock applications across machine learning and the physical sciences.

</details>


### [356] [Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01527)
*Kabir Murjani,Nisarg Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究固定行为策略下采集的数据能否区分两个候选正则决策过程（RDP），证明观测等价候选间的后验几率恒等于先验几率，并给出判定等价性的线性时间算法PEC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RDP离线学习保证依赖行为策略的可区分性假设，却无法验证该假设；一旦假设不成立，不同模型可能同样好地解释数据。因此需要刻画数据在何种条件下能区分两个候选RDP。

Method: 将非马尔可夫环境建模为RDP（动态依赖由有限自动机刻画的历史）；以贝叶斯后验几率作为可区分性判据，证明观测等价候选的后验几率与先验几率在所有样本量下相等（即使策略遍历所有自动机状态），并在Lean 4中形式化验证；进而精确刻画这种等价关系，导出在乘积自动机规模上线性时间的判定算法PEC。

Result: 证明并形式化了后验几率不变性；给出等价的精确刻画与线性时间判定算法PEC；在四个测试环境中，先前工作的可区分性假设有三个失效，而PEC识别出的实验在每种情况下都能恢复该假设。

Conclusion: 数据本身可能无法区分结构不同的RDP，可区分性应由实验设计而非事后假设保障；PEC提供了可验证、线性时间的等价判定与实验识别手段，弥补了既有离线保证的缺口。

Abstract: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.

</details>


### [357] [Calibrating Prediction Timeliness Through Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01530)
*Tugrul Cabir Hakyemez,Ener Uras Gokhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将RUL预测的超参数优化目标本身视为设计变量，在C-MAPSS和BackBlaze基准上比较单目标（最大化R²、最小化NASA评分）与多目标（NSGA-II+Entropy-CRITIC）三种策略，发现多目标优化在保持精度的同时降低方向性失衡约33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测性维护中，早期与晚期RUL预测误差的后果是不对称的，但超参数优化通常只针对单一精度指标，对两个方向同等对待，无法反映这种不对称代价。

Method: 把优化目标本身当作设计变量，评估五种架构（MLP、LSTM、XGBoost、TCN、Transformer）在三种机制下的表现：单目标最大化R²、单目标最小化NASA评分函数、以及同时优化两者的多目标形式；多目标搜索采用NSGA-II并结合Entropy-CRITIC加权进行Pareto选择，共评估75个模型-数据集-策略组合。

Result: 在C-MAPSS上，各策略精度相当（R²≈0.89），但多目标优化使方向性失衡降低约33%，改善了早期与晚期预测的校准；模型排名依赖于配置，较简单架构常优于更深的时序模型。在BackBlaze上，两个目标由互补转为冲突，产生不同的Entropy-CRITIC权重并出现显著泛化差距（最佳R²≈0.34）。

Conclusion: 优化目标实质性地塑造了预测行为，多目标搜索为校准RUL建模中的预测及时性提供了一种实用机制。

Abstract: In predictive maintenance, early and late RUL prediction errors carry asymmetric consequences, yet hyperparameter optimization typically targets a single accuracy metric that treats both directions equally. This study treats the optimization objective itself as a design variable. Five architectures (MLP, LSTM, XGBoost, TCN, and Transformer) are evaluated under three regimes: single-objective maximization of $R^2$, single-objective minimization of the NASA scoring function, and a multi-objective formulation that jointly optimizes both criteria. The multi-objective search employs NSGA-II with Entropy-CRITIC weighting for Pareto selection. Seventy-five model-dataset-strategy combinations are assessed on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan and BackBlaze hard-disk drive benchmarks. On C-MAPSS, all strategies achieve comparable accuracy ($R^2 \approx 0.89$), yet multi-objective optimization reduces directional imbalance by approximately 33%, improving calibration of early versus late predictions. Model rankings prove configuration-dependent, with simpler architectures frequently outperforming deeper temporal models. On BackBlaze, the objectives shift from complementary to conflicting, producing divergent Entropy-CRITIC weights and a substantial generalization gap (best $R^2 \approx 0.34$). These results demonstrate that the optimization objective materially shapes prognostic behavior and that multi-objective search provides a practical mechanism for calibrating prediction timeliness in RUL modeling.

</details>


### [358] [FedFit: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Vector-Bank Parameterization and Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01537)
*Hang Zou,Chao Zhang,Yuzhi Yang,Yu Tian,Samson Lasaulce,Mérouane Debbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedFit框架，通过不相交共享向量库参数化与交替优化调度，在联邦LoRA微调中实现比标准方法高至100倍的压缩比，且困惑度性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习支持LLM的隐私保护微调，但通信开销是瓶颈；同时在FL中应用LoRA存在"聚合困境"：精确的乘积之和（SoP）与通信高效的求和之积（PoS）难以兼顾。

Method: 1) 不相交共享向量库参数化：用两个紧凑且不相交的全局向量库重构高维适配器矩阵，降低通信开销；2) 交替优化调度：在解耦的单库更新（可精确聚合）与由残差谱聚合机制校正的联合更新之间循环，化解SoP与PoS冲突；3) 块量化结合客户端误差反馈进一步压缩传输向量。

Result: 在Qwen2.5模型上的大量实验表明，FedFit取得与标准联邦LoRA方法相当的困惑度性能，同时压缩比最高提升100倍。此外，论文给出了所提算法的理论收敛性保证。

Conclusion: FedFit通过向量库参数化与交替优化，有效缓解联邦LoRA的通信瓶颈与聚合困境，在保持性能的同时大幅提升压缩效率，并具备理论收敛保障。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the massive communication overhead remains a critical bottleneck. Furthermore, applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in FL faces a fundamental "aggregation dilemma" between the accurate Sum-of-Products (SoP) and the communication-efficient Product-of-Sums (PoS) implementations. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedFit. First, to significantly reduce communication overhead, we introduce a disjoint shared vector-bank parameterization that reconstructs high-dimensional adapter matrices from two compact and disjoint global vector banks. Second, to address the aggregation dilemma, we devise an alternating optimization schedule. By cycling between decoupled single-bank updates (which allow for accurate aggregation) and joint updates corrected by a Residual Spectral Aggregation mechanism, we resolve the conflict between SoP and PoS. Additionally, we integrate blockwise quantization with client-side error feedback to further compress the transmitted vectors. Furthermore, we establish theoretical convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that FedFit achieves perplexity performance comparable to standard federated LoRA methods, while providing compression ratios up to 100x higher.

</details>


### [359] [Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01548)
*Ryunyi Lee,Kangjun Noh,Somin Kim,Heedong Kim,Kyungwoo Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Range-GRPO 半监督后训练框架，将 LLM-as-a-Judge 的伪奖励表示为保形校准的奖励区间，在 GRPO 中以区间两两比较替代点奖励比较，从而让不确定性影响策略梯度信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 后训练需要可靠监督，但许多领域缺少参考答案或可执行验证器，标注成本高。LLM-as-a-Judge 可提供可扩展伪奖励，然而单一标量分数无法显式表达奖励不确定性。

Method: 将伪奖励建模为保形校准的奖励区间（conformally calibrated reward ranges），结合少量标注数据与无标注提示进行半监督后训练。在 GRPO 中不再把奖励区间归约为点奖励，而是对同一 rollout 组内的奖励区间进行成对比较，构建新的优化目标，使区间不确定性同时影响学习信号的幅度与方向。

Result: 理论分析刻画了区间比较目标与点奖励目标的差异，并证明当所有奖励区间退化为点时，该目标可还原 Dr.GRPO 的优势函数。实验上，Range-GRPO 在所评估的半监督方法中取得最高的分布内与分布外平均性能，同时所需训练资源更少。

Conclusion: 以保形校准奖励区间替代点式伪奖励，并将不确定性显式引入 GRPO 的相对比较机制，是一种更可靠且更高效的半监督后训练路径。

Abstract: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges. We propose Range-GRPO, a semi-supervised post-training framework that combines limited labeled data with unlabeled prompts. In Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), learning signals depend on relative reward comparisons within each rollout group. The proposed objective compares reward ranges pairwise rather than reducing them to point rewards, allowing interval uncertainty to affect both the magnitude and direction of these signals. Our theoretical analysis characterizes this distinction and shows that the proposed objective recovers the Dr.GRPO advantage when all reward ranges collapse to points. Empirically, Range-GRPO achieves the highest in-distribution and out-of-distribution average performance among the evaluated semi-supervised methods while requiring fewer training resources.

</details>


### [360] [QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01554)
*Ivan Ilin,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QK-Wanda剪枝方法，联合评分query与key权重，在15个模型上降低QK重构误差并提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wanda方法在剪枝大语言模型时，对每个线性投影内的权重独立评分，但query与key通过点积相互作用，独立评分忽略了这种耦合关系，可能导致次优的剪枝决策。

Method: 提出QK-Wanda，在无掩码的pre-RoPE重构目标下，依据权重各自的删除代价对query和key权重评分；用对侧投影信息（key信息用于query权重，query信息用于key权重）增强Wanda评分，使两个投影共享剪枝预算；评分具有闭式解，无需梯度或权重更新。

Result: 剪枝耗时仅比Wanda多1.3%（A100）和3.1%（H200）。在TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3、Qwen2.5共15个模型（0.5B-72B）上，QK重构误差在50%稀疏度平均降低60%，80%稀疏度降低45%。Llama 2 70B在80%稀疏度下WikiText-2与C4困惑度下降20.3%和13.5%，零样本平均准确率提升5.94个百分点；Qwen2.5-72B同样改善，但Llama-3.1-70B困惑度显著升高。

Conclusion: 结果表明耦合剪枝准则具有潜力，同时揭示局部重构误差作为模型质量预测指标的局限性。

Abstract: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

</details>


### [361] [Towards Optimal Policy Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01566)
*Yaniv Oren,Viliam Vadocz,Wiktor Zabka,Thomas Evers,Jan Robine,Wendelin Böhmer,Matthijs T. J. Spaan,Martha White,Hendrik Baier,Fenghui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从第一性原理研究策略改进，将受限条件下的最优策略改进刻画为求解诱导MDP，并在近似评估约束下把greedification形式化为不确定性下的概率决策，推导出最优算子，其梯度近似在多种RL算法与设定中提升整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实用强化学习算法依赖在近似评估条件下的迭代策略改进，但现有方法缺乏对"最优策略改进"这一概念的系统性理论刻画，尤其是如何在近似评估这一核心现实约束下进行最优的greedification，尚缺乏第一性原理层面的理解与 principled 的算子设计。

Method: 1) 将最优策略改进定义为在给定约束下单次更新可达到的最佳策略；2) 证明限制在状态子集上的最优改进等价于求解一个诱导MDP（induced MDP），从而把基于显式或隐式模型的规划统一理解为通向最优策略改进的路径；3) 将近似评估约束下的greedification建模为不确定性下的概率决策问题，并据此推导出一个对相应目标函数最优的新算子，同时给出其基于梯度的实用近似。

Result: 所提算子及其基于梯度的实用近似在GumbelAlphaZero、SAC、ReBRAC与Generalized Policy Iteration上均提升了整体性能，实验覆盖离散与连续动作、基于模型与无模型、在线与离线强化学习等多种设定。

Conclusion: 本文将策略改进的最优性建立在第一性原理之上，给出了"最优改进=求解诱导MDP"的形式化刻画，并在近似评估的核心约束下提出了有理论最优性保证的greedification算子，实验表明其具有跨算法、跨设定的一致有效性。

Abstract: Practical Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms learn to solve Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) through iterative policy improvement in the presence of approximate evaluation. We study policy improvement from first principles, defining optimal policy improvement as producing the best policy attainable in a single update under specified constraints. We show that optimal improvement restricted to a set of states is equivalent to solving an induced MDP, characterizing planning with an explicit or implicit model as a path towards optimal policy improvement. Because practical methods commonly solve such induced problems through iterative improvement in the form of greedification, we take steps towards optimal greedification under the central practical constraint of approximate evaluation. We formulate greedification under this constraint as probabilistic decision-making under uncertainty and derive a novel operator that is optimal with respect to the resulting objective. Empirically, the operator and its practical gradient-based approximations improve aggregate performance across GumbelAlphaZero, SAC, ReBRAC and Generalized Policy Iteration, in experiments spanning discrete and continuous actions, model-based and model-free, online and offline RL.

</details>


### [362] [Beyond Pointwise Error: A Multi-Metric Evaluation of Spatial Climate Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01579)
*Loys Masquelier,Etienne Le Naour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对ERA5温度、风速和降水场上的五种空间降尺度方法进行多指标基准测试，发现空间保真度与细尺度变率之间存在系统性权衡，方法排名随指标和变量而变化，因此不存在单一最优的降尺度方法，多指标评估十分必要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候降尺度旨在从粗分辨率输入重建精细尺度空间场，但其质量评估存在困难：低逐点误差可能以牺牲细尺度变率为代价，而真实的空间变率也可能伴随不准确的局部结构。由于评估指标会改变哪种方法看起来最优，因此需要多指标综合评估。

Method: 该工作提出了一个多指标基准，在ERA5温度、风速和降水场上比较五种空间降尺度方法，采用五项标准评估互补特性：逐点误差、结构相似性、分布误差、谱误差和梯度误差。

Result: 结果揭示了空间保真度与细尺度变率之间的系统性权衡。一些方法在逐点和空间对齐指标上表现最佳，但丢失了高频内容；另一些方法保留了显著更多的谱变率，但局部结构定位不够准确。因此，方法排名在不同指标和变量之间发生变化。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明不存在单一最优的降尺度方法，多指标评估对于评估气候场中哪些属性得以保留至关重要。

Abstract: Climate downscaling aims to reconstruct fine scale spatial fields from coarse resolution inputs. Evaluating the quality of these reconstructions is challenging: low pointwise error can come at the cost of fine scale variability, while realistic spatial variability can be achieved with inaccurate local structures. The evaluation metric can therefore change which method appears to perform best. This work presents a multi metric benchmark comparing five spatial downscaling methods on ERA5 temperature, wind, and precipitation fields. Five criteria assess complementary properties: pointwise error, structural similarity, distribution error, spectral error, and gradient error. The results reveal a systematic trade off between spatial fidelity and fine scale variability. Some methods perform best on pointwise and spatially aligned metrics, but lose high frequency content, while others preserve substantially more spectral variability at the cost of less accurately positioned local structures. Consequently, method rankings change across metrics and variables. These results show that there is no single best downscaling method. Multi metric evaluation is therefore essential for assessing which properties of a climate field are preserved.

</details>


### [363] [Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01590)
*Yuan Huang,Zihan Chen,Runbin Zhang,Hongwei Ding,Changzeng Fu,Shiqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究持续学习中任务专属适配器（adapter）在预训练ViT各block中的放置位置问题，提出基于人脑fMRI编码模型的LS-B方法，无需搜索即可选定适配器位置，性能接近全量适配器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在持续学习中为每个任务在ViT每个block保留专属适配器会导致存储随任务数线性增长；仅在少数block放置适配器可抑制增长，但"放在哪些block"这一问题缺乏明确答案。论文希望在不做昂贵位置搜索的前提下找到合适的适配器放置策略。

Method: 1) 算法视角：穷举所有连续四个block的放置位置进行训练，分析精度随深度变化；并测试基于权重谱或激活统计的低成本准则。2) 神经科学视角：借鉴视觉皮层层级结构与中期可塑性，提出LS-B方法——用冻结的fMRI编码模型（覆盖12个人脑视觉区）观察最初若干任务，将任务专属容量一次性分配给在任务间读数变化最大、相对结构最稳定的block。该方法不需要标签、不需要反向传播。

Result: 穷举连续四block放置的训练精度呈倒U形：最终精度在中间深度达到峰值，不同位置差异最高达3.5个百分点；而基于权重谱或激活统计的低成本准则偏向最深层block。LS-B在三个ViT-B/16骨干上给出稳定且骨干特异的分配。在可做位置搜索的AugReg与iBOT两个骨干上，LS-B所选block与搜索识别出的中间深度区域重叠。在存储与观察预算匹配条件下，所选block优于最浅与最深四block配置。在Split ImageNet-R上，LS-B仅用全量BiLoRA适配器存储的60%，最终精度差距在1.5个百分点以内；分配过程无需标签与反向传播，额外运行时间不到0.6%，并呈现骨干特异的皮层特征。

Conclusion: 适配器放置存在中间深度最优的经验规律，但低成本启发式准则偏向深层；借助外部神经科学测量（fMRI编码模型）可在不做搜索的情况下定位有效放置位置。LS-B在显著降低适配器存储的同时保持接近全量适配器的精度，且开销极低，表明外部生物学测量可作为层间专门化的有效指导信号。

Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

</details>


### [364] [Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01601)
*Guy Amit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出候选独立块因果注意力机制，通过阻断候选间信息流并重置候选位置，降低决策模型对候选序列排列的敏感性，同时保持决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型常对编码于单一序列中的可变大小候选动作集合进行评分，这一场景在生成式系统的System 1组件中日益重要，因为候选可能在不同运行中以不同方式被提出或排序。标准因果交叉编码虽表达能力强，但会使候选得分依赖于序列化顺序而非底层决策问题本身。

Method: 提出候选独立块因果注意力（candidate-independent block-causal attention）：在共享上下文和每个候选内部保留因果计算，同时阻断候选之间的信息流并重置候选位置。在Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B和Qwen3 4B骨干上，将该架构与标准因果注意力及互补的不变性基线进行对比。

Result: 候选独立注意力持续降低排列敏感性，同时保持有竞争力的决策质量；消融实验表明候选隔离是效果的主要来源，位置重置则补全了预期的对称性。更大规模的Qwen3-4B研究进一步考察了该架构在显著更多训练数据下的行为。

Conclusion: 候选独立块因果注意力有效缓解了决策模型对候选序列化顺序的依赖，提升排列不变性且不牺牲决策质量，为生成式系统中System 1组件的稳健候选评分提供了可行方案。代码与模型已公开。

Abstract: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{https://github.com/guyAmit/ci-decision-models}{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{https://huggingface.co/Guy-Amit/qwen3-4b-ci-decision-4096-poc}{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [365] [Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01619)
*Constance Douwes,Paul Magron,Romain Serizel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于共享计算平台活动日志的方法，估算深度学习项目开发阶段（架构原型设计与实验迭代）的能源成本，并以LORIA实验室Multispeech团队的四个音频项目为例。结果表明开发阶段能耗是训练最优模型能耗的3至256倍，呼吁对深度学习音频项目全生命周期能耗进行系统化报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去十年深度学习的环境影响日益受关注，但已有研究主要聚焦于模型训练与推理的能耗和碳排放，而整个开发阶段（architecture prototyping与intensive experiments）常被忽视，这一阶段能耗极高，因此需要量化其成本。

Method: 提出一种能耗估算方法，基于Grid5000共享计算平台（LORIA实验室使用）的活动日志；以Multispeech研究团队的音频项目为案例，估算四个项目的整体能源成本，并与报告中已发表模型的训练能耗进行对比。

Result: 开发阶段所需能源是单独训练最佳性能模型的3至256倍。

Conclusion: 研究结果主张对基于深度学习的音频项目全生命周期（whole life cycle）的能耗进行更系统化的报告。

Abstract: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.

</details>


### [366] [Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01633)
*Sahel Torkamani,Henry Gouk,Rik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"幅度势"（magnitude potential），一种基于度量幅度理论的量，用于衡量任意点被给定集合表示的程度，并将其应用于分析神经网络泛化现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释神经网络的泛化能力和训练动态仍是难题，已有多种方法从不同角度研究这些现象，但缺乏一个统一的几何量来刻画点的表示质量。

Method: 引入幅度势，即基于度量幅度理论的量；计算某类别的幅度势与整个数据集的幅度势之比（在logit层计算），用于刻画该点的表示；将单个训练点的比值与Feldman记忆分数相关联，并聚合各类比值。

Result: 单个训练点的幅度势比值与Feldman记忆分数相关；聚合的幅度势比值能检测决策边界的结构性变化，并为模算术中的grokking提供几何指标；即使显式抑制神经坍缩，该比值仍具信息量。

Conclusion: 幅度势比值是神经网络泛化与训练动态分析的有效几何工具，其信息量独立于神经坍缩现象。

Abstract: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.

</details>


### [367] [FedSAP: Federated Learning with Structured Adaptive Partitioning for Multi-Domain Heterogeneous Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01638)
*Wentao Yue,Tianyou Lai,Hongji Li,Qingyu Mao,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedSAP：面向异构边缘设备的域感知联邦学习框架，将结构化剪枝建模为预算约束下的三态通道分配，实现稳定通道全局池、域敏感通道私有池与低效用通道丢弃，在Digits和Office-Caltech上平均全局精度分别达76.00%与72.67%，支持高达80%的客户端剪枝率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构边缘设备上的联邦学习需同时应对不均衡的资源预算与域偏移的本地数据。现有资源自适应方法仅决定客户端训练多少模型，而未规定保留容量应位于何处及如何共享；联邦域泛化方法通常假设共享完整架构。统一压缩会丢弃高效用通道，单一聚合路径会混合可迁移特征与域敏感更新。

Method: FedSAP将结构化剪枝转化为预算约束下的三态通道分配：把每个保留率转换为非均匀层预算，将稳定通道分配到Global池、有用的域敏感通道分配到伪域特定Private池、低效用通道置为Dropped状态。域引导分配（Domain-Guided Assignment）通过浅层梯度相似度推断伪域；类型匹配聚合（Type-Matched Aggregation）限制每个通道仅在其预定共享范围内聚合。

Result: 在三个随机种子下，FedSAP在Digits和Office-Caltech上的平均全局精度分别为76.00%和72.67%，较最强基线分别高出1.70和4.92个百分点，同时在异构客户端上支持高达80%的客户端剪枝率。

Conclusion: 通过将通道按效用与域敏感性进行三态划分并匹配对应聚合范围，FedSAP在资源受限与域偏移并存的异构联邦学习场景中兼顾了可迁移特征的跨客户端共享与域敏感更新的隔离，显著优于现有基线。
